title: Awakening Sleeping Beauties at The Met
summary: AI can enrich lives through beauty and creativity, and its artistic potential shines in "Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion," a collaborative exhibit from The Met's Costume Institute.
body: AI can enrich lives through beauty and creativity, and its artistic potential shines in "Sleeping Beauties: Reawakening Fashion," a collaborative exhibit from The Met's Costume Institute.
summaryZh: 大都会艺术博物馆服装学院推出了“睡美人：时尚再觉醒”展览，展示了AI在艺术创意和美学方面的潜在应用。
